summary.headline: Theophilus on Fixed Stars
summary.text: Discussion of lunar applications and separations from the stars, including effects of void-of-course and afflicted Moon placements on character, eyesight, occupations, and sexual conduct. Begins an edited chapter by Theophilus on fixed stars, comparing Angelicus, Parisinus, and Marcianus codices, Palchus, Ptolemy, and stellar longitudes for Arcturus and Regulus.
